title: Four Servings of What? Too Small.
text: Four Servings of What? Too Small.. I trust the George Foreman name and I wanted something that could grill a quick meal whenever I felt like it. Four servings? How does that work when barely two hamburgers fit on it at one time? Since you have no heat controls, I went by the guide which offers little in the way of suggested cooking times. I timed a strip steak for rare and ended up with well done. This grill gets uncontrollably hot in my opinion. I am not sorry that I purchased this since it has a few uses for the price, but I must always check for not overcooking. But when it comes to steaks and burgers, I wish I had chosen a much larger model with temperature controls.

features: 4 Servings - Feed the whole family fast! The 60 square inches of grilling surface lets you make up to four servings of everybody’s favorites all at the same time
Classic Plate Grill - This is the original George Foreman Grill. The durable grill plates give you lean, mean grilling power for all your favorite foods. Plus, it doubles as a Panini press
George Tough Nonstick Coating - It’s durable, easy to clean, and removes the need for butter and oil
Fat-Removing Slope - It’s the sure sign of a George Foreman Grill. The sloped grilling surface helps remove up to 42% of fat* from meats for lean, tasty meals
Drip Tray -The dishwasher-safe drip tray collects excess fat and grease so you don’t have to, How nice is that?
description: It’s the kitchen appliance that changed the grilling game forever. The George Foreman 4-Serving Classic Plate Grill and Panini delivers fast grilling and delicious results for steak, burgers, chicken, veggies, and more. The patented sloped surface helps remove fat during cooking, and the George Tough nonstick coating wipes clean after every use. This compact grill is perfect for small families, and its dual contact heating speeds up grilling to get food on the table in record time. What will you make on your George Foreman Grill? *from 1/4lb. uncooked 80/20 ground chuck
